method.cli: new process, warmed filesystem caches; fixture/directory preparation excluded
method.listener: one process, sequential stdin request to complete handler output; startup excluded
method.durability: local filesystem fsync + rename + directory sync; not a power-loss simulation
method.ordering: shuffled CLI cases; separate sequential listener batches
method.safety: temporary files only; no external API or Git operations

scripts.pipeline.program:
run printf with message "checkpoint fixture"
then tr with from "[:lower:]" and to "[:upper:]"
then save to file "output.txt"
scripts.listener.program:
listen to stdin
whenever a line arrives as record
  read "input.txt"
